title: Best Scenic and Landscape Photographers (2026): Stock and Prints
description: How to hire a scenic or landscape photographer for prints, tourism, websites or stock: licensing, resolution, locations, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Scenic photographers capture landscapes, cityscapes, nature and travel scenes for prints, tourism marketing, websites, book covers and decoration. Many sell existing images; others shoot specific locations on request. Good scenic photos have strong composition, light and resolution. Projects go wrong when licenses are unclear, resolution is too low for printing, or images are heavily edited in ways that misrepresent a place. This guide helps you buy or commission scenic images confidently.

faq.q: What resolution do I need for prints?

faq.q: Can they shoot a specific location?
faq.a: Yes, if they can travel there. Weather and season affect timing.

faq.q: Can I use the photos commercially?
faq.a: Only with the right license. Agree on use, duration and exclusivity.
